strategy.overview: Each Z-O-N-E completion advances Tri Zone's four-stage scoring ladder, while either A-B lane pair raises Bonus X. The first Z-O-N-E completion lights the spinner, the second raises the top eject to 10,000, the third makes every Z-O-N-E target worth 10,000, and the fourth lights alternating outlane Specials. A roving lamp also marks one Z-O-N-E drop for 10,000.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit whichever Z-O-N-E drop is flashing for 10,000. Complete all four drops once to light the spinner, twice to raise the top eject to 10,000, and three times to make every Z-O-N-E target worth 10,000. Complete either A-B lane pair repeatedly to raise Bonus X toward 5x.
strategy.summary: Take clean, grazing shots at the flashing Z-O-N-E target when it faces the active flipper; otherwise shoot to the top for A-B and T-R-I progress. The third Z-O-N-E completion is the durable scoring payoff because all four targets then stay worth 10,000 for the rest of the ball.

quickInfo.name: Score 10,000
quickInfo.summary: Hit the currently flashing Z-O-N-E target.

steps.text: Hit the currently flashing Z-O-N-E drop for 10,000; unlit drops score 1,000.
Complete all four drops once to light the spinner.
Complete Z-O-N-E a second time to raise the top eject hole to 10,000, then a third time to light every Z-O-N-E target for 10,000.
Complete either the top or lower A-B lanes repeatedly to raise Bonus X toward 5x.

alternatives.title: Bonus-and-T-R-I route
alternatives.when: Use this when the low drop targets are returning dangerously.

steps.text: Shoot to the top and complete A-B for Bonus X.
Collect T-R-I for its lit progression: 3,000, 5,000, 10,000, then the configured Extra Ball and Special awards.
Return to Z-O-N-E only when a flashing target offers a clean edge shot.
Build base bonus toward 19,000 with T-R-I, A-B, lanes, and targets.
Protect the ball once 19,000 at 5x is lit; the resulting end-of-ball bonus is 95,000.

machineSetup: Test all four Z-O-N-E drops and resets, the roving lamp sequence, both A-B lane pairs, T-R-I lanes, spinner, top eject, pop bumpers, outlane lamps, and the full bonus ladder.
Confirm T-R-I Extra Ball and Special settings, outlane Special value, Bonus X operation, and that the roving lamp advances at the intended pace without skipping a target.

cautions.issue: The Z-O-N-E targets sit low and can return directly toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Prefer grazing or backhanded hits on the flashing target and return to safer top-lane feeds when no clean target face is available.
